_help: Copy of this file lives in colleges/<slug>/config/college.json. Fill every CHANGE_ME. Leave a field out to use the generic default from pipeline/college_config.py. USC's filled-in version: colleges/usc/config/college.json.
name: CHANGE_ME Full Official Name
_discovery: Stage 2. Sites the college owns on other domains (student paper, athletics, hospital). Hostname first-labels of portals and tools to skip are regex fragments.
_selection: Stage 5. url_keywords_extra adds this college's words to the generic keyword lists (regex, joined with |). Categories: culture, extracurriculars, quirks, academics, research, social_impact, innovative_programs, intellectual_alignment, diversity_international, news.
_fetching: Stage 4/6. Only change expand_button_text if a page needs a button clicked (cloud Firecrawl).
_structured: Stage 7-10. structured_url_patterns (regex) = pages your parsers handle, so they are never sent to the AI. news_hosts_capped = the college's own newsroom hosts. school_hosts = schedule school code -> school website host.
_documents: Stage 11. news_domains/trusted_news_domains: add the student paper and local outlets to the generic national list (copy the defaults from pipeline/college_config.py first). identity_words: the college's name, nickname, mascot and tradition words (lowercase).
_report: Stage 11-12. recall_items: 40-50 specific things a good researcher expects to find. known_gaps: college-specific limits, one sentence each.
